purpose: Generalization diagnostic only: determine whether observed omission and ordinal-hedging patterns extend beyond the original ten-film calibration set. This is not a gold set or formal validation set.
coverageLimitations: This is a 12-film diagnostic sample, not a balanced validation design or a replacement for the future 45-film gold evaluation.
The available clean candidates do not produce an even cross-product of every taxonomy axis, genre, language, and cardinality combination.

decisionRules.generalizedEvidenceDeficit: Repeated omissions of relaxing, easy-watch, or friends persist outside the original ten-film set.
decisionRules.sampleSpecificDeficit: Those omissions largely disappear in this diagnostic sample.
